documentation_excerpts.text: **A fast, security-first static analyzer with heuristic auto-fix for GitHub Actions workflows.**
Find injection, credential leakage, supply-chain, and pipeline-poisoning bugs in `.github/workflows/` — and let `-fix` repair most of them for you.

- **Security-first by design.** Full coverage of the [OWASP Top 10 CI/CD Security Risks](https://owasp.org/www-project-top-10-ci-cd-security-risks/) — code/env/path/output injection, untrusted checkouts, artifact & cache poisoning, ref confusion, impostor commits, and more. - **Semantic, not regex.** A real AST + expression parser + shell taint analyzer (`mvdan.cc/sh`) — not string matching.
